definitions.explanation: The count of written characters (kana, kanji, numerals, etc.) in a piece of text. Used for essays, application forms, and online posts that impose length limits.

examples.japanese: {字数|じすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{字数|じすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: The report doesn't have enough characters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{字数|じすう}{制限|せいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{八百字|はっぴゃくじ}だ。
examples.english: This essay has a character limit of 800.

notes:
Refers to how many characters a text contains, counting each kana, kanji, or symbol as one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字数|じすう}{制限|せいげん}: character limit
- {字数|じすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count the characters
- {字数|じすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to have enough characters
- {字数|じすう}⟦オーバー→オーバー：01529_oobaa⟧: over the character limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文字数|もじすう}→文字数：29489_mojisuu⟧: character count — near-synonym, more common when talking about digital text and input fields
